name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the University of Porto, he volunteered at a local karting track. The raw energy and mechanical intricacies captivated him, leading him to abandon his initial plans of working in automotive manufacturing. He climbed the ranks, starting as a junior mechanic, then race engineer, and eventually found his niche as a chief engineer, thriving on the challenge of optimizing performance and leading technical teams.

His approach is meticulous and data-driven, emphasizing rigorous testing and precise adjustments. Ricardo is known for his relentless pursuit of marginal gains, believing that even the smallest improvements can make a significant difference on the track. He is demanding but fair, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement within his team. His experience in endurance racing with Herberth Motorsport has instilled in him a deep understanding of reliability and strategic planning, making him a valuable asset.

Ricardo's distinctive trait is his encyclopedic knowledge of motorsport history and technical regulations. He can often be found referencing old race reports or citing obscure clauses in the rulebook to gain a competitive edge. His passion for the sport is infectious, inspiring his team to push the boundaries of performance and innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years spent in the demanding environment of the garage.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on using a specific brand of stopwatch for timing pit stops.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
